expected_lineup_loss_on_production.classification_evidence: Expected value favors the candidate; no admissible terminal ground. Reliable trait; the large oracle positive control does not bound a candidate-sized effect.
expected_lineup_loss_on_production.description: LEAD-62: production weak_stack plus frozen expected starter loss in offense, defense and QB; opener probability-rule accuracy
expected_lineup_loss_on_production.notes: Measured: 246/456 vs 243/456 correct; 28 pick disagreements; 2020 n=220 effect=-1.363636 accuracy points probability_positive=0.109; 2021 n=236 effect=2.542373 probability_positive=0.89465. Coverage: 256 games each 2014-2020, 272 in 2021, 271 in 2022, 272 each 2023-2024, zero in 2025. Reliability 0.8262005 across 352 team-seasons. 20000 week bootstraps seed 20260902. Legacy depth uses pregame week proxy, actual observation times unverified. Pool-cutoff features are opener-graded, not Tuesday-time inputs. Initial training-restricted null retained for audit; final production controls preserve all baseline training rows.
expected_lineup_loss_on_production.plain_summary: Estimate the starter value each team may miss from playing chances and recent workload, and add that information to the existing picks.
